expression_signature.eyes: half-lidded, slightly unfocused gaze, looking past the speaker at a middle-distance point on the wall — not making eye contact, not avoiding it on purpose, just... checked out
expression_signature.brows: flat, neither raised nor furrowed — the absence of expression IS the expression
expression_signature.mouth: closed, lips together with a tiny breath-out between them, slight asymmetry (left corner a millimeter lower than right)
expression_signature.head: level, neither tilted up nor down, facing forward but eyes off-target
expression_signature.overall_impression: the face of a man who has heard this sentence many times before and knows no reply will help — used heavily in Page 4-6 (morning argument), Page 13 (gossip defense), Page 16 (birthday silence)

inherit_from_base.wardrobe_default: as in base-v1 — loose grey cotton t-shirt + navy plaid pajama pants
inherit_from_base.default_posture: shoulders slightly slumped, neck slightly forward

micro_motion.static: sitting on sofa edge or standing in doorway, hands at sides or one hand holding phone loosely
micro_motion.subtle_motion: slow blink once every two seconds; a micro-exhale that lifts shoulders barely a centimeter; thumbs pinching phone case

lighting_preference_for_this_expression.preferred: flat ambient room light with one dim source off-camera — no dramatic shadows, the blandness itself is the message
lighting_preference_for_this_expression.avoid: dramatic spotlight or backlit silhouette — would add drama the moment doesn't have
lighting_preference_for_this_expression.narrative_pairing: best paired with living_room_sofa scene anchor; the moment right after a spouse sentence lands
